# runr_workflow_trigger (Resource)

One trigger of a durable workflow: an event (with an optional condition), a cron schedule or a queue stream. Exactly one of `event`, `cron` and `queue` is set.

The workflow must exist and be declared through the API (`runr_workflow` without `triggers`, `runr workflows declare`, `PUT /api/projects/{project}/workflows`) or by `runr.workflows.json`; the resource adds its trigger to the definition and leaves the definition's other triggers and options as they are (`PUT /api/projects/{project}/workflows/{workflow}`: the project's other definitions are not touched). Workflows whose definitions the function's SDK reports get their triggers from the code: change them there.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The workflows are declared through the API, e.g. `runr workflows declare -f runr.workflows.json`.

# Start process-order for large orders.
resource "runr_workflow_trigger" "large_orders" {
  project_id = runr_project.orders.id
  workflow   = "process-order"
  event      = "order.created"
  condition  = "event.data.total > 1000"
}

# Every message of the project's queue stream "orders" starts a run.
resource "runr_workflow_trigger" "orders_queue" {
  project_id = runr_project.orders.id
  workflow   = "process-order"
  queue      = "orders"
}

# The nightly report at 03:00 Istanbul time.
resource "runr_workflow_trigger" "nightly" {
  project_id = runr_project.orders.id
  workflow   = "nightly-report"
  cron       = "0 3 * * *"
  timezone   = "Europe/Istanbul"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project id.
- `workflow` (String) Workflow name.

### Optional

- `condition` (String) Expression the event must satisfy (`if`), e.g. `event.data.total > 100`; event and queue triggers.
- `cron` (String) Five-field cron expression; the engine starts one run per due minute.
- `event` (String) Event name that starts a run, e.g. `order.created` (letters, digits and `. _ : / -`).
- `queue` (String) Redis stream of the project's queue bridge; each message starts a run (event `queue/<stream>`).
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone of `cron`, e.g. `Europe/Istanbul` (default UTC).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project_id>/<workflow>/<event:NAME | queue:STREAM | cron:EXPRESSION[@TIME_ZONE]>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project name or id>/<workflow>/<event:NAME | queue:STREAM | cron:EXPRESSION[@TIME_ZONE]>
terraform import runr_workflow_trigger.large_orders orders-api/process-order/event:order.created
terraform import runr_workflow_trigger.nightly 'orders-api/nightly-report/cron:0 3 * * *@Europe/Istanbul'
```
